title: Items Registry File (items.json)
description: Schema for the items registry. Per ADR-0005, items are pure-data Registry File entries with optional scene references for world-droppable items. The items.json file at project root maps item ids to item definitions.

category.description: Top-level category. Drives default UI affordances and inventory grouping.

weight.description: Weight in grams. Used for encumbrance.

world_drop_scene.description: Optional. scene:* URN for the world representation when this item is dropped. Items not droppable in the world (key items, abstract resources) omit this field.

properties.description: Category-specific properties. The validator extends with per-category sub-schemas (weapon has damage, tool has tool_type, food has nutrition, etc.).

tags.description: Optional informal tags for filtering and storylet preconditions. Tags are not centrally registered; each project documents conventions in its README.

gear_category.description: Per the Project Halcyon design doc. Conventional gear (iron axes, crossbows, swords, hide armor, salted meat) accumulates no Drift on use. Drift-Powered gear (Tesla weapons, ritual implements, Heart-Class artifacts, certain consumables) accumulates Drift per use, scaled by the Drift Accumulation Curve. Items omit this field if neither applies (raw materials, abstract resources).

drift_on_use.description: Drift accumulation per use of this item. Per-use baseline; the engine multiplies by the Drift Accumulation Curve at runtime. Required when gear_category is 'drift_powered'; ignored when gear_category is 'conventional' or absent.

lore.description: Optional lore text. Surfaced in item-inspect UI and consumable by storylets.
